principle: error_type=Code Formatting: RST documentation heading formatting is strictly validated by documentation build tools (Sphinx, docformatter). Top-level sections require both overline and underline markers that exactly match the title width, while subsections require underlines matching title length. Violations cause CI documentation checks to fail, blocking merges regardless of code correctness. (seen in repos: flower)
fix_strategy: Run docformatter or sphinx-build in check mode on RST files to identify heading violations. For each heading: ensure top-level titles have overlines (same characters as underline) of equal width to title text, and all underlines match title length exactly. Use automated tools to auto-fix or manually correct underline/overline lengths.
fix_direction: Run docformatter or sphinx-build in check mode on RST files to identify heading violations. principle: error_type=Docs Formatting: RST documentation files require underline characters (e.g., =, ~, *, -) beneath section headers to conform to reStructuredText specification. CI validators like mdformat, docformatter, and sphinx-build will fail when these underlines are missing or shorter than the header text. Additionally, plugin import errors in formatting tools can mask underlying RST heading validation failures. (seen in repos: flower)
fix_strategy: Add proper underline characters to all RST section headers: use '=' for top-level titles, '-' for secondary headers, '~' for subsections, and '*' for emphasis. Ensure each underline is at least equal in length to the header text. Run rst-lint or sphinx-build to validate after fixing.

principle: error_type=Docs Formatting: RST documentation files require both overline and underline decorations on section titles to comply with reStructuredText formatting standards. Missing overlines cause docformatter, sphinx-build, and rst2html validation tools to fail because they cannot properly parse the document hierarchy. This formatting requirement is universal across all RST-based documentation systems. (seen in repos: flower)
fix_strategy: Add overline decorations (matching or exceeding the length of the section title text) using characters like #, =, -, or ~ above every section title in RST files. The overline character should match the underline character for consistency (e.g., #################### for main sections with underline of equal length).
